title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Terms of Sale — Taking a Reservation
content:
**1. Reservation type.** A Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation is taken only for the type that matches the state of the item. Each type has its own entry condition:

| Reservation type | State of the item | Payment at reservation |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Back-Order | Size temporarily out of stock in the Marlowe & Finch warehouse, with a replenishment date | No deposit |
| Supplier Direct Back-Order | Out of stock at Marlowe & Finch and available from the brand's own warehouse | No deposit |
| Seasonal Pre-Order | Next-season style announced with a ship window | No deposit |
| Launch Pre-Order | Limited launch with a launch date and capped stock | Card authorized at reservation |
| Deposit Pre-Order | Designer collection piece produced to pre-order volume | Card deposit at reservation |
| Made-to-Order Reservation | Made-to-order footwear built to the customer's confirmed size and personalisation | Card deposit at reservation |

**2. Ship-by date.** Every reservation states an original ship-by date. That date is no later than the type's furthest initial ship-by period, counted in calendar days after the reservation date. Where no date can be stated, the ship-by date is the reservation date plus the type's unstated ship-by period in calendar days.

**3. Units.** A reservation carries no more than the type's maximum units per reservation.

**4. Promotion codes.** Promotion codes never apply to reservations, under the Online Orders terms.

**5. Launch opening.** A Launch Pre-Order can be reserved from the public opening time on the launch date. A customer may reserve earlier by the launch pre-order early-access hours of their Marlowe Rewards tier, because early access applies to this type.

**6. Card authorization.** Where the type authorizes the card at reservation and captures at shipment, the card is authorized at reservation for the unit price times the quantity, plus estimated tax.

**7. Deposit charge.** Where a deposit applies, it is charged at reservation, to a card only.

**8. Former deposit amount clause.** The clause that set the deposit as the type's deposit percentage of the unit price times the quantity, rounded half up to the cent and never less than the type's minimum deposit, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current deposit basis.

**9. Personalisation.** A Made-to-Order Reservation records the personalisation exactly as the customer gives it, letter for letter.

### Points of judgement

| Situation | Result under these terms |
|---|---|
| The ship-by date offered falls on the last day of the type's furthest initial ship-by period | Within clause 2 |
| The ship-by date offered falls the day after that last day | Not a ship-by date these terms allow |
| No ship-by date can be stated at all | The ship-by date is the reservation date plus the unstated ship-by period |
| A reservation would carry one unit more than the type's maximum | Not taken in that form (clause 3) |
| A promotion code is offered against a reservation | It does not apply (clause 4) |
| A Launch Pre-Order is requested before the public opening time | Possible only within the early-access hours of the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier (clause 5) |

superseded_clauses: The deposit is `deposit_pct` percent of unit price times quantity, rounded per `deposit_rounding`, but never less than `deposit_min_usd`.
